verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST Cloud API with a published OpenAPI spec for creating and managing resources. Instances can be launched programmatically, and cloud-init can run workload setup at launch, so provisioning and running work need no console. The unofficial community MCP/CLI earns no credit itself, but it shows the API supports launching and terminating instances. Monitoring is evidenced only through console pages and Grafana dashboards, there is no official CLI or MCP server, and teardown is implied by "manage" rather than explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs for API termination, API-based instance status/health monitoring, an official CLI or MCP server, independent hands-on corroboration of the full end-to-end loop.
